spotlights.name: Bryce Deadmon
spotlights.title: Olympic Gold Medalist
spotlights.body: Track Houston alumnus Bryce Deadmon won Olympic gold in the men's 4x400m relay and bronze in the mixed relay at Tokyo 2020. At the 2022 World Championships in Eugene, he split 43.82 on the winning 4x400m. Before Texas A&M and Team USA, he was a Track Houston athlete.
spotlights.imageAlt: Bryce Deadmon smiles with the American flag draped over his shoulders after winning gold at the World Championships.
spotlights.caption: Bryce Deadmon with the flag after 4x400m relay gold at the 2022 World Championships in Eugene.

spotlights.name: Alaysha Johnson
spotlights.title: Olympic Finalist · Paris 2024
spotlights.body: Track Houston alumna Alaysha Johnson ran a personal-best 12.31 to take second at the 2024 US Olympic Trials, then made the 100m hurdles final at the Paris Games — seventh in the world. From Track Houston to the University of Oregon to the Olympic final.
spotlights.imageAlt: Alaysha Johnson in Team USA kit clears a hurdle at the Paris 2024 Olympic Games.
spotlights.caption: Alaysha Johnson clears a hurdle in her Team USA debut at the Paris 2024 Olympics.

college.headline: From Houston to everywhere.
college.body: Coupling academic performance with athletic accomplishment, Track Houston athletes have earned scholarships at more than 50 colleges and universities across the country.
